purpose: Record one provenance-preserving row per alias occurrence while preventing private source passages and cross-dimension lifecycle differences from being misclassified as contradictions.

field_contracts.occurrence_id: Stable opaque identifier; must not contain quoted source text or personal data.
field_contracts.raw_value: Only the minimal label or name token necessary for continuity resolution; no surrounding private passage.
field_contracts.normalized_value: Canonical comparison value without implying canonical project-name status.
field_contracts.entity_type: Typed structural role such as project_name, abbreviation, repository_name, visual_branch_or_mode_label, document_series, or derived_compendium_or_module_family.
field_contracts.lifecycle_dimension: Explicit dimension from the lifecycle registry; scanner fallback is allowed only for schema_version 1 compatibility.
field_contracts.lifecycle_status: Status within the declared lifecycle dimension.
field_contracts.claim_status: One of observed, inferred, proposed, superseded, or unresolved.
field_contracts.confidence: One of high, medium, or low, with unresolved preferred over unsupported promotion.
field_contracts.source_reference: Repository path and immutable SHA, or private-source title plus non-content locator; never copy private prose.
field_contracts.source_visibility: One of public_repository, private_file_library, private_chat_history, or derived_artifact.
field_contracts.observed_at_or_range: ISO timestamp, date, bounded date range, or unknown; uncertainty must be retained.
field_contracts.evidence_strength: One of direct_source, corroborated_summary, deterministic_derivation, or weak_context.
field_contracts.review_state: One of accepted, needs_review, conflict, superseded, or privacy_blocked.

validation_rules: Reject an occurrence lacking lifecycle_dimension in schema_version 2.
Reject source_reference values containing copied private passages.
Treat different lifecycle_status values as a conflict only when normalized_value and lifecycle_dimension both match.
Do not promote unresolved or weak_context evidence to canonical project identity.
Preserve raw_value even when normalized_value resolves to an existing entity.
Require review_state=privacy_blocked when minimal safe provenance cannot be represented without exposing private material.
migration_rules: Schema-version-1 rows may derive lifecycle_dimension from the lifecycle registry by entity_type.
A derived lifecycle_dimension must be marked evidence_strength=deterministic_derivation.
Unknown entity types migrate to unresolved_dimension and review_state=needs_review.
Migration must be additive; original artifacts remain immutable and addressable.

claim_states.observed: The existing typed alias registry stores alias summaries but not one complete provenance row per occurrence.
claim_states.inferred: Occurrence-level provenance is necessary to distinguish language evolution from project renaming without reproducing private text.
claim_states.proposed: All new continuity occurrence artifacts should conform to this schema-version-2 contract.
claim_states.superseded: A normalized label plus one undifferentiated lifecycle status is sufficient for contradiction detection.
claim_states.unresolved: Historical labels still require decision-log evidence before stronger lifecycle promotion.

falsification_route: Construct two rows with the same normalized_value but different lifecycle dimensions; they must not conflict. Construct two rows with the same normalized_value and lifecycle_dimension but different lifecycle_status values; they must enter review_state=conflict.

privacy_boundary.included: Minimal labels, typed roles, abstract status, source titles or repository paths, hashes, bounded dates, confidence, and evidence strength.
privacy_boundary.excluded: Raw private passages, personal narrative, health data, relationship material, financial data, credentials, and identifying conversational context.

next_action: Add valid and invalid fixtures plus deterministic validation to the continuity scanner, then run the committed tests in trusted CI.
